_comment: web-dev project settings. In v2 the harness ships its own hooks inside the plugin, so this file registers NO hooks: the gate is already running before a project has any settings at all, and a copy of the hook scripts inside each project is a copy that goes stale. What stays here is the part a repository genuinely owns — offering the plugin to whoever clones it, and the permission denies that shape how this project is worked on.
_plugin: extraKnownMarketplaces and enabledPlugins offer the web-dev plugin to everyone who clones this repository and trusts the folder, so the instructions arrive with the enforcement rather than after it.
_deny: EnterPlanMode is denied because this project plans through the approved brief. Worktree isolation is denied because a fresh worktree moves the project root away from the manifest paths the gate checks, and a worktree created behind the gate's back is a tree it never inspects.
